data.content: IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW BOUNCE (Codex, 20260703T195017Z). Must-fix: ackMessage can report success and create an .acked marker for a message that does not exist. In cli/src/mcp-tools/agent-message-store.ts:512-533 the marker is opened/created before readInboxMessage, and if readInboxMessage returns not-found, the function still returns { acked: true, alreadyAcked: false }. This violates the P1/design invariant that delivery/ack state is derived from a real result and reintroduces false-success semantics. Fix by reading/verifying the message first, returning a non-success/not-found result without creating a marker for missing/corrupt records, and add regression coverage for absent-message ack and tampered/malformed ack paths.
